scientific.integrity: The source AdamW recurrence is reduced exactly on a scalar quadratic. Bias correction makes the second moment constant on the alternating orbit for arbitrary beta2, while the beta2=0 slice becomes an explicit one-dimensional odd map whose contraction and cycle multiplier are proved directly.
limitations: The first-moment coefficient is fixed at beta1=0.
Global convergence and cycle stability are classified only for beta2=0.
The objective is a deterministic scalar quadratic.
The result concerns optimization dynamics, not statistical generalization.

title: Decoupled weight decay lowers the exact chattering threshold in AdamW
